	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_Increase_metallurgy_trigger_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes }

					which = DA_Metallurgy_exp
					value = 1000
				}
			}
			AND = {
				DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes
				NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes }
				check_variable = {
					which = DA_Metallurgy_exp
					value = 2500
				}
			}
			AND = {
				DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes
				NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes }
				check_variable = {
					which = DA_Metallurgy_exp

	}
}

DA_SCH_two_elements = {   # S3 (doc 82): Arcane Arts III asks for two of the four elemental studies
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_SCH_two_elements_tt
		OR = {
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Air = yes }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Air = yes }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Air = yes }
		}
	}
}
